source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data report builder was run across all 1,199 priced, addressless Savills legacy appearances dated 2014. Two hundred and forty-seven matches were retained only where the exact hammer price, locality or postcode district, tenure and property class aligned to one compatible transaction completing within 60 days of the auction. Seven hundred and thirty-five no-compatible-result, 197 multi-candidate, 18 later-completion and two duplicate-transaction lot candidates were left unchanged. Original Savills/PropertyAuctions evidence and every repeat auction appearance remain preserved.
